description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the PayloadMapping interface, providing functionality to create, access, and serialize a list of string mappings related to payload processing within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package.

classes.name: ImmutablePayloadMapping
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the PayloadMapping interface, encapsulating a list of string mappings and providing methods for creation, JSON serialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty PayloadMapping instance.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a PayloadMapping instance from a given list of strings.

methods.name: getMappings
methods.description: Returns the list of string mappings.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the mappings list is empty.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the mappings list into a JsonArray.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PayloadMapping object from a JsonArray containing string values.
